issue_request: FHIR-15587 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by Vocab and asked to change CodeSystem.valueSet comments so the associated value set includes all codes from this code system, only codes from this code system, and is immutable.
initial_application: The request was applied in git-svn commit c4c972c0ce (svn r13127) by changing the CodeSystem spreadsheet comment from "all codes from this code system" to "all codes from this code system and only codes from this code system" while preserving the immutable requirement. Commit 2909be206c (svn r13130) normalized the spreadsheet with no content change.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current authoritative StructureDefinition source carries the seed rule. Later Published Vocab decisions FHIR-36837 and FHIR-36942 refined the same all-codes wording to clarify independent-of-status inclusion and valid code compositions; both related decisions are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current CodeSystem.valueSet definition and comment already include all requested FHIR-15587 semantics and preserve later Vocab-approved refinements.
